description: This file defines the DashboardPage class as a page object in a Selenium-based UI automation framework, representing the Dashboard page in the OrangeHRM application.

classes.name: DashboardPage
classes.description: A page object representing the Dashboard page, extending the BasePage class and providing a method to verify if the page is loaded.

methods.name: isLoaded
methods.description: Checks if the Dashboard page is loaded by verifying the presence of the header element.
